restrictions.text: protocol_version = 86 (nearcore 2.13.4) for every epoch of the claim, mainnet runtime parameters RuntimeConfigStore::new(None).get_config(86)
the epoch's shard layout is ShardLayout V2 or V3 with 1..=64 shards
all epochs of the claim have the byte-identical shard layout (no resharding); no non-empty outgoing buffer to a shard outside the layout
block headers V6; chunk header inners V4/V5
no dynamic-resharding split check for any applied block
the last new chunk of the shard is not the genesis chunk
the chain segment has at most 32 blocks
state witness <= 8 MiB; sum of the main transition's base_state values and the contract code blobs + 2000 x ContractData removals <= 4,000,000 bytes (the storage-proof limit never triggers)

no DeployGlobalContract / UseGlobalContract / DeterministicStateInit action, no GlobalContractDistribution receipt, no ML-DSA-65 key in any decoded transaction or receipt (incl. receipts created by contracts); transactions carry ED25519 keys and signatures
no SECP256K1 Delegate signature is verified
the BandwidthSchedulerState value is absent or decodes as V1

every executed contract prepares inside D3α: integer WASM only (no float type or opcode); no executed FunctionCall calls a curve host function (alt_bn128_*, bls12381_*, ecrecover, p256_verify) or a state-init / global-contract / gas-key host function (importing them is allowed); no unmodeled VM outcome
every FunctionCall receiver's contract is None or Local (global identifiers out of domain); no FunctionCall on an ETH-implicit account with a Local contract (legacy-wallet resolution)

cold-cache statement: the code of every executed pre-state contract must be in the witness (else reject); out of domain when such a blob is absent and the same code was deployed earlier in the chunk (committed or rolled back): nearcore's verdict then depends on its compiled-contract cache
the chunk's sum of gas_burnt_for_function_call (incl. host gas) <= G_alpha = 2^22 x 822,756 gas (NearSpecV3.D3.gAlpha), checked after the main transition

hardware_profile.cpu_model: AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D 16-Core Processor (local operator host; 8 vCPUs pinned per run)

classes.description: [D0] D0 chunks with no incoming receipt and no implicit transition: context authentication, empty main transition, bandwidth scheduler, congestion info, Reed-Solomon encoded merkle root
[D0] D0 chunks applying >= 1 incoming cross-shard Transfer receipt, no implicit transition
[D0] D0 chunks after >= 1 missing chunk of the shard (implicit transitions), chains with 25% chunk skips
[D1] D1 chunks whose last chunk's Transfer transactions all succeed (cross-shard and local self-transfers, V0/V1, monotonic/strict nonces)
[D1] D1 chunks with >= 1 Transfer transaction that fails validation or is skipped (an adversarial chunk producer's crafted validity classes: signatures, nonces, keys, balances, expiry, duplicates)
[D1] D1 chunks without transactions in the last chunk (incoming Transfer receipts, new_transactions only, missing chunks) on D1 chains
[D2] D2 chunks with every non-WASM action kind, multi-action receipts, Delegate, refunds, data / yield receipts, no queue or epoch feature
[D2] D2 chunks with a non-empty delayed-receipt queue or outgoing buffer before or after the chunk (congestion, bandwidth requests)
[D2] D2 chunks whose segment crosses an epoch boundary or applies a ValidatorAccountsUpdate (validator proposals, stakes)
[D3a] D3a chunks executing >= 1 WASM FunctionCall without callbacks: storage reads/writes/removes, logs, value returns, cross-contract promises, deploy-and-call, gas exhaustion, failures
[D3a] D3a chunks with callbacks (promise_then / promise_and joins, promise results, yields and resumes)
[D3a] D3a chunks that execute no WASM (D2 traffic around contract state: deploys, yield timeouts, forwarded FunctionCall receipts)
[D3a] max-G_alpha class: D3a chunks whose function-call gas is >= G_alpha / 2 (the heaviest chunks a D3a proof must carry)

weight_source.note: Documented assumption (no measured per-chunk mix of these features exists in the repository yet): mainnet traffic is dominated by FunctionCalls, so the D3a classes carry 65% (calls 30%, callbacks 15%, max-G_alpha 15%, non-WASM chunks around contract state 5%); non-WASM receipts/queues/epochs (D2) 17%; plain transfer transactions (D1) 10%; quiet / transfer-receipt / missing-chunk D0 chunks 8%. To be replaced by a measured mix from mainnet replay (docs/HISTORICAL_REPLAY.md) in a versioned successor.
